scope: ALL_SAVED: current successful MCP_AUTO and MANUAL_HISTORY versions for the enabled server-resolved project/account only. One current version per account/day; only missing dates excluded. No collection, configuration or fact writes. Restores saved table values, not original uploaded file formatting or discarded data.

mapping.columns: 32 columns from manual-history-upload-v1.json in exact order
mapping.percent: raw percentage-number divided by 100 -> Excel numeric percentage
mapping.date: Excel numeric whole day; source creation time reduced to date (offset timestamps in Asia/Shanghai)
mapping.unknown: missing/null/empty/UNKNOWN -> blank; required template inputs fail if absent
mapping.formulas: literal source names escaped, no formulas created

consistency: Each preview/download independently uses a repeatable-read readonly snapshot, validates account/day/version identity and row/content hashes. Manual content SHA is the ordered raw JSON rows joined with commas inside brackets; MCP retains its importer canonical hash rule. Decimal payload parsing preserves source precision independently of hash verification. Preview is not a reservation.

builder.dependencies: Python standard library only; shipped template and column contract
builder.numericEncoding: Decimal text -> OOXML numeric cell, percent divided by 100 without binary float intermediate; Excel's own numeric precision limits remain
builder.textEncoding: OOXML inlineStr, literal text even if it begins with =
builder.evidence: test_export_saved_data.py 32-column upload roundtrip plus independent Excel reader; PortableWorkbookTest actual subprocess and cleanup
builder.legacyReference: build_collected_export.mjs retained, not used by current application runners

security: Loopback peer and allowed Host/Origin; no-store responses; sanitized error codes; no raw facts in logs. Generated input and workbook removed after bytes are read.
